_readme: Source registry. Static facts only; runtime status (last success, failures) is in apprentice/ledger/source_checks.jsonl. Tiers: A primary/official, B licensed data, C reputable original reporting, D aggregator/commentary (lead only). 'terms_checked' turns true only after the provider's current terms/limits were read and recorded in 'limitations'.

sources.name: Reuters Markets
sources.limitations: Paywall/licensing; scraping not permitted. Use as headline/link reference found via search; no automated collection.

sources.name: Bloomberg Markets
sources.limitations: Paywalled; terms forbid scraping. Link reference only.

sources.name: CNBC Markets
sources.limitations: Public RSS headlines; full articles not stored. Feed URL to verify.

sources.name: Financial Times
sources.limitations: Paywalled; link reference only.

sources.name: The Wall Street Journal
sources.limitations: Paywalled; link reference only.

sources.name: MarketWatch
sources.limitations: Public RSS headlines (Dow Jones); metered paywall on articles.

sources.name: Yahoo Finance
sources.limitations: Aggregator/syndication: many stories are reposts. Unofficial price endpoints are NOT used (terms).

sources.name: Associated Press Business
sources.limitations: No official public RSS confirmed; link reference via search.

sources.name: Barron's
sources.limitations: Paywalled; link reference only.

sources.name: Investing.com
sources.limitations: Aggregator; terms restrict scraping of data pages. RSS headlines only; economic calendar via manual check.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR
sources.limitations: Free JSON API (data.sec.gov). Requires a descriptive User-Agent with contact info; max 10 requests/second. US issuers only.

sources.name: Nasdaq
sources.limitations: Website data pages; no free official API for quotes. Use as reference.

sources.name: NYSE
sources.limitations: Market data is licensed; reference for holidays/hours only.

sources.name: TMX / TSX
sources.limitations: TMX market data is licensed; no free API. Used for official holiday calendar and notices (manual).

sources.name: Company investor-relations sites and earnings releases
sources.limitations: Per-company; found via search. Primary source for company facts.

sources.name: FINRA Data
sources.limitations: Short interest and other data; API requires registration. Not integrated in V1.

sources.name: CFTC Commitments of Traders
sources.limitations: Weekly (Fridays, data as of Tuesday). Public reports; integration later.

sources.name: TradingView
sources.limitations: No public data API; terms forbid scraping. Charts/reference only.

sources.name: Federal Reserve
sources.limitations: Official press release RSS. FOMC calendar is manual.

sources.name: FRED (St. Louis Fed)
sources.limitations: Free API key required. Series revise over time: store the vintage you used.

sources.name: US Bureau of Labor Statistics
sources.limitations: Public API v1 without key (limited); CPI/jobs also available via FRED.

sources.name: US Bureau of Economic Analysis
sources.limitations: API needs a free key; GDP also via FRED.

sources.name: US Treasury
sources.limitations: Yield curve data public; integration later (also via FRED).

sources.name: Bank of Canada
sources.limitations: Valet API, free, no key: USD/CAD and policy rate. Used for all currency conversion.

sources.name: Statistics Canada
sources.limitations: Web Data Service, free. CPI/jobs integration later; dates via release calendar.

sources.name: US Energy Information Administration
sources.limitations: API needs a free key; oil inventories weekly. Later.

sources.name: Alpha Vantage
sources.limitations: Free tier about 25 requests/day; quotes are end-of-day/delayed (no bid/ask). TSX via the .TRT suffix (to verify).

sources.name: Massive (formerly Polygon.io)
sources.limitations: Free tier is US-only and end-of-day with a small per-minute limit (to verify). Not integrated in V1.

sources.name: Finnhub
sources.limitations: Free tier: US quotes, company news, earnings calendar; 60 calls/min. Non-US data mostly premium.

sources.name: Financial Modeling Prep
sources.limitations: Free tier about 250 calls/day, mostly US fundamentals. Later.

sources.name: Twelve Data
sources.limitations: Free tier about 800 calls/day, 8/min; data delayed. TSX availability on the free plan is UNCONFIRMED.

sources.name: Tiingo
sources.limitations: Free tier US end-of-day + news; 50 symbols/hour limit. Later.

sources.name: Nasdaq Data Link
sources.limitations: Mostly premium datasets; free ones limited. Later.

sources.name: StockAnalysis
sources.limitations: No public API; terms restrict scraping. Reference via search only.

sources.name: CoinDesk
sources.limitations: Public RSS headlines.

sources.name: CoinGecko
sources.limitations: Demo plan (free key) about 30 calls/min, 10k/month. Prices are aggregated across exchanges, not tradable quotes.

sources.name: CoinMarketCap
sources.limitations: Basic plan (free key) 10k credits/month. Later; CoinGecko used first.

sources.name: Cointelegraph
sources.limitations: Public RSS; mixes news with opinion and sponsored posts. Treat as a lead only.

sources.name: Decrypt
sources.limitations: Public RSS headlines.

sources.name: The Block
sources.limitations: RSS headlines; some research paywalled.

sources.name: CoinDesk Data API
sources.limitations: Free tier needs key; check terms. Later.

sources.name: CoinGecko News API
sources.limitations: Plan availability to verify. Later.

sources.name: Coinbase blog
sources.limitations: Company blog: primary for Coinbase's own announcements, promotional otherwise.

sources.name: Kraken blog
sources.limitations: Company blog: primary for listings/delistings on Kraken.

sources.name: DefiLlama
sources.limitations: Free public API, no key: protocol TVL, chain TVL, stablecoin supply.

sources.name: Kraken public market data (extra)
sources.limitations: Free, no key. Real bid/ask for CAD pairs, so it is the crypto fill price source. Added because the paper trader needs a tradable quote.

sources.name: SEDAR+ (extra)
sources.limitations: Official Canadian filings. No public API; manual/search reference. Added because TSX companies don't file on EDGAR.

sources.name: Bank of Canada Valet API (extra entry for the endpoint)
sources.limitations: Same publisher as #24; tracked separately because it is the FX endpoint used for every USD conversion.
